column1: #@source motanka-stack-shell
#@packages motanka-stack-shell
# Upstream components of motanka-stack-shell: Quickshell, the desktop shell
# of upstream Omarchy v4.5.0, and cpptrace, which its crash handler needs.
# Same format as stack/components.tsv (see the comment there). Built by
# packaging/motanka-stack-shell/debian/shell-build.sh in file order, for
# both suites: against motanka-qt6 on noble and the archive's Qt 6.10 on
# resolute.
#   wayland-protocols  build time only, the Stack's version (1.50, same
#                      tarball and checksum as stack/components.tsv), so
#                      Quickshell sees the same protocols as Hyprland on
#                      both releases.
#   libdwarf-lite      build "source": not built on its own. cpptrace's
#                      CMake fetches it from git at configure time, which
#                      the network-less sbuild chroot cannot do, so the
#                      build points FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_LIBDWARF at this
#                      folder. The version must be the one cpptrace pins as
#                      CPPTRACE_LIBDWARF_TAG; shell-build.sh fails when
#                      cpptrace names a different version.
#   cpptrace           shared, with libunwind (Quickshell's crash handler
#                      refuses it otherwise); libcpptrace ships in
#                      motanka-stack-shell.
#   quickshell         the GitHub mirror's tag; no git submodules.
# Download, verify and pin: stack/fetch-sources --components stack/shell-components.tsv
# name
wayland-protocols
libdwarf-lite
cpptrace
quickshell
